summary: Admit st-test heavy phases through native resource profiles and retain phase receipts

replay.detail: No replicated claims or projection changes.

schema.detail: No database changes. The local run ledger gains additive admission_receipts entries naming each phase, profile and terminal receipt file.

rules.detail: Member preparation and each heavy check take one native resources exec admission in lane st-test, class check. Independent load, cargo-slot, priority, lane-burst, builds.slice, gate-slot and nice/ionice admission paths are removed. Admission and payload clocks remain separate.

compatibility.detail: Requires native resources exec with --profile and --receipt-file; these flags remain provisional until the native profile contract merges. There is no legacy fallback or ST_EVIDENCE_GOVERN=off bypass. Unsupported hosts refuse heavy phases.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart is performed by this change.

manual.detail: Before adoption, install the native resources CLI/daemon and provision st-test-build and st-test-run host profiles with cores, memory, a host-specific warm-run disk estimate and heavy IO. The default single member serializes the st-test lane. Receipts persist under ~/.cache/st-test/admission.

recovery.detail: Revert the runner change to restore its previous admission policy. Existing signed evidence and terminal receipts are not rewritten.
